Here’s a polished, ready-to-record **podcast script** for your Doctor’s Biome episode on *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge.* It keeps your usual tone — educational, conversational, and story-driven — and follows your intro-sponsor-conversation flow.

## 🎙 Podcast Script  
**Episode Title:** *Living Probiotics & The Future of Gut Health with David Finkelstein of Doctor’s Biome*  
**Host:** Bethany Gifford  
**Guest:** David Finkelstein, CMO of Doctor’s Biome  

---

### INTRO
**Bethany:**  
Hi everyone, and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge.* I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and today we’re diving deep into one of the most fascinating intersections in modern wellness — how **gut health connects to aesthetics, hormones, and longevity.**  

But first, a quick word from our sponsor…  

*(insert sponsor segment)*  

Now, joining me today is **David Finkelstein**, Chief Marketing Officer at **Doctor’s Biome** — a pioneering company redefining gut health with **living, liquid probiotics.** Their formulations are alive, growing, and delivered in organic juices that serve as both probiotic and prebiotic sources — helping the body restore balance at a cellular level.  

Doctor’s Biome was founded through the collaboration of **Dr. Howard Robbins**, a leader in ozone therapy; **Dr. Reza Kamari**, an MIT PhD and NASA-trained food scientist; and **David’s family**, who helped bring years of research and development to life in a product that’s now transforming the way we think about gut health and whole-body vitality.  

David, welcome to the show — I’m so excited to have you here.  

---

### SEGMENT 1 — THE ORIGIN STORY
**Bethany:**  
Let’s start at the beginning. What inspired the creation of Doctor’s Biome, and how did your partnership with Dr. Robbins and Dr. Kamari come together?  

*(David answers)*  

That’s amazing. I love hearing stories where science and family align around a shared purpose. Those early years of research sound intense — what did that R&D journey look like in creating a living product that could actually survive the digestive system?  

---

### SEGMENT 2 — THE SCIENCE OF LIVING PROBIOTICS
**Bethany:**  
For our listeners who might be used to taking probiotics in capsules or powders, what makes Doctor’s Biome so different?  

*(David answers)*  

So instead of freeze-dried bacteria that often die in the stomach, these are **living organisms** that stay active and multiply?  

*(Bethany follow-up)*  

That’s incredible. Can you explain how the **organic juice base** enhances absorption and results — almost like pairing prebiotics and probiotics together?  

*(David answers)*  

And I imagine **shelf life** and **live-culture growth** play huge roles in keeping the potency high, right?  

---

### SEGMENT 3 — CHALLENGES & BREAKTHROUGHS
**Bethany:**  
Every innovation comes with hurdles. What were some of the biggest challenges you faced creating a viable live product — especially one that has to stay refrigerated and maintain stability over time?  

*(David answers)*  

That’s fascinating. Balancing the science with the education side must also be a challenge — helping people understand why living probiotics matter. How do you approach that balance between **education and marketing** in such a noisy supplement market?  

*(David answers)*  

And as you scale, how are you managing **small-batch production** and distribution while maintaining that clinical-grade quality?  

---

### SEGMENT 4 — B2B GROWTH & PRACTITIONER PARTNERSHIPS
**Bethany:**  
One of the things I love about Doctor’s Biome is your focus on **provider partnerships** — med spas, wellness clinics, nutritionists. How are you connecting with practitioners to help them integrate gut health into their offerings?  

*(David answers)*  

That’s such a smart move. So for a med spa owner listening today, how could something like Doctor’s Biome become both a **revenue stream** and a **patient-retention tool**?  

*(David answers)*  

And I know you place a lot of emphasis on **practitioner education** — why is that such a core piece of your strategy?  

---

### SEGMENT 5 — THE FUTURE OF GUT HEALTH IN AESTHETICS
**Bethany:**  
As we look ahead, where do you see the connection between **gut health, hormones, and skin vitality** going over the next few years?  

*(David answers)*  

That makes perfect sense — especially as more patients and providers shift toward an “inside-out” approach to beauty and longevity.  

*(Bethany follow-up)*  

And finally, what’s next for Doctor’s Biome? Are there any new innovations, collaborations, or research directions you’re most excited about?  

*(David answers)*  

---

### CLOSING
**Bethany:**  
David, this has been such an enlightening conversation. I love seeing companies bridge the gap between clinical science and everyday wellness in such a tangible way.  

For our listeners, you can learn more about **Doctor’s Biome** and explore their living probiotics at **doctorsbiome.com** or follow them on social media to stay up to date on new launches and educational resources.  

Thank you again for joining me, and thank you all for listening to another episode of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge.* If you enjoyed today’s episode, don’t forget to subscribe and share it with a friend who’s passionate about wellness from the inside out.  

Until next time — stay well, stay curious, and keep leading this new era of health.  

---
